command.text: declare @message nvarchar(4000) select @message = '' &PrintRightGridShowing;&VisibleFieldGridShowing; select @message as message return

action.text:
declare @q nvarchar(max), @slstt_rec nvarchar(max) select @slstt_rec = text from @lstt_rec
select top 0 @slstt_rec as data, b.line_nbr, b.stt_rec, cast(null as varchar(max)) as ddyn, ma_td1 as d_ma_td1, ma_hd as d_ma_hd, ma_sp as d_ma_sp, ma_vv as d_ma_vv , @q as d_tk_vt, @q as d_so_ct0, @q as d_ten_vv, ma_td3 as d_ma_td3, @q as d_ten_td3 into #m from d&ddTable;$000000 b right join (select null as v) x on 1 = 0
insert into #m(data) select data from [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$Split](@slstt_rec, char(252)) a where id > 1
update #m set line_nbr = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 1, char(253)), stt_rec = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 2, char(253))
if '&ddTable;' in ('42', '83', '26') update #m set ddyn = 'd&ddTable;$000000' else begin set @q = 'update #m set ddyn = ''d&ddTable;$'' + convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from #m a join c&ddTable;$000000 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' exec (@q) end
select top 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_td1, ma_hd, ma_sp, ma_vv, tk_vt, ma_td3 into #d from d&ddTable;$000000 b right join (select null as v) x on 1 = 0 set @q = '' select @q = @q + 'insert into #d select stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_td1, ma_hd, ma_sp, ma_vv, tk_vt, ma_td3 from ' + ddyn + ' a where exists(select * from #m where stt_rec = a.stt_rec);' from #m where ddyn <> '' group by ddyn exec (@q)
select top 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, so_ct0, tk_thue_no into #r30 from r30$000000 b right join (select null as v) x on 1 = 0 set @q = '' select @q = @q + 'insert into #r30 select stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, so_ct0, tk_thue_no from r30$' + right(ddyn, 6) + ' a where exists(select * from #m where stt_rec = a.stt_rec);' from #m where ddyn <> '' group by ddyn exec (@q)
update #m set d_ma_td1 = b.ma_td1, d_ma_hd = b.ma_hd, d_ma_sp = b.ma_sp, d_ma_vv = b.ma_vv, d_ma_td3 = b.ma_td3 from #m a join #d b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and b.line_nbr = 1
update #m set d_ten_vv = case when @@language = 'v' then ten_vv else ten_vv2 end, d_ten_td3 = case when @@language = 'v' then ten_dtqt else ten_dtqt2 end from #m a left join dmvv b on a.d_ma_vv = b.ma_vv left join dmdtqt3 c on a.d_ma_td3 = c.ma_dtqt select stt_rec, tk_vt, row_number() over(partition by stt_rec order by min(xtype), tk_vt) as ln into #tk_vt from ( select stt_rec, 1 as xtype, tk_vt from #d group by stt_rec, tk_vt union all select stt_rec, 2, tk_thue_no from #r30 group by stt_rec, tk_thue_no ) a group by stt_rec, tk_vt
update #m set d_so_ct0 = b.d_so_ct0 from #m a join ( select a.stt_rec, STUFF(( select ', ' + rtrim(ltrim(so_ct0)) from #r30 b where stt_rec = a.stt_rec group by so_ct0 ORDER BY so_ct0 FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS d_so_ct0 from #r30 a group by a.stt_rec) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
update #m set d_tk_vt = b.d_tk_vt from #m a join ( select a.stt_rec, STUFF(( select ', ' + rtrim(tk_vt) from #tk_vt b where stt_rec = a.stt_rec ORDER BY ln FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS d_tk_vt from #tk_vt a group by a.stt_rec) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
select '' as array$, rtrim(a.d_ma_td1), rtrim(a.d_ma_hd), rtrim(d_ma_sp), rtrim(d_ma_vv), d_tk_vt, d_so_ct0, rtrim(d_ma_td3), d_ten_td3, d_ten_vv from #m a order by line_nbr return

query.text: declare @$pageCount int; select @$pageCount = case when @@pageCount < 0 then 0 else @@pageCount end; exec FastBusiness$App$Voucher$Loading @@id, @@master, @@prime, @@partition, @@expression, @@extension, @$pageCount, 'stt_rec', @@textList, @@textExternal, 'a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh', @@textOrderBy, @@admin, @@userID, @@viewAccessMode, 0, @@queryString

select top 0 * into #filter$rr from #filter$dd if exists(select 1 from #filter$dd where field = 'd_so_ct0') begin insert into #filter$rr(field, type, conditional) select field, type, conditional from #filter$dd where field = 'd_so_ct0' update #filter$rr set field = 'r30_so_ct0', conditional = replace(conditional, 'd_so_ct0', 'r30_so_ct0') where field = 'd_so_ct0' delete #filter$dd where field = 'd_so_ct0' end
&ddFinding;
if exists(select 1 from #filter$rr) begin if @$detailPartition is null set @$detailPartition = '' if @$detailAlias is null set @$detailAlias = '' if @$detailFilter is null set @$detailFilter = ''
set @$detailPartition = @$detailPartition + case when @$detailPartition = '' then '' else char(255) end + 'r30$%Partition' set @$detailAlias = @$detailAlias + case when @$detailAlias = '' then '' else char(255) end + 'zrr' set @$detailFilter = @$detailFilter + case when @$detailFilter = '' then '' else char(255) end + ''
select @$detailFilter = @$detailFilter + case when id = 1 then '' else ' and ' end + replace(replace(conditional, char(255) + field, 'zrr' + '.' + field), 'zrr.r30_', 'zrr.') from #filter$rr order by id
--set @$detailFilter = '(' + @$detailFilter + ') and zdd.line_nbr = 1' end
exec FastBusiness$App$Voucher$Finding @@id, @@master, @@prime, @@inquiry, @@partition, @@expression, @@increase, @@extension, @@refresh, @@pageIndex, @@pageCount, @@lastPage, @@lastCount, @@firstItem, @@lastItem, @@keyMaster, @@keyDetail, 'stt_rec', @@textList, @@textExternal, 'a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh', @@textOrderBy, @@admin, @@userID, @@viewAccessMode, @ngay_ct1, @ngay_ct2, @so_ct1, @so_ct2, @status, @user_id0, @ma_dvcs
